messages:
marta: Quick sync — we need to schedule the quarterly access review + privacy/threat modeling session for the infra services. Prefer one 60m slot. Agenda I’m proposing: 1) RBAC audit summary, 2) service account inventory + retirements, 3) PII flow review (S3 + logs), 4) threat model open items, 5) action owners. Can people add conflicts & any must-have items?

vikram: +1 for 60m. blocked Wed morning (calendar conflict). prefer Tue/Thu afternoon. add: key rotation status and KMS access list.

sasha: I can do Tue 2–4pm PT, Thu 3–5pm PT. also request a short pre-read: current ACL export and last audit CSV.

noah: Thu afternoon works for me. can we include a quick check on onboarding/offboarding checklist? saw a couple stale accounts last month.

marta: noted. pre-read list: ACL export, service-account.csv, last threat-model doc link (posted below). please drop any specific CI/CD or dedicated infra services you want covered.

sec-bot: POLL: React with :one: for Tue 2pm PT, :two: for Tue 3pm PT, :three: for Thu 3pm PT, :four: for Thu 4pm PT. Poll closes in 48h.

vikram: reacted :three: (Thu 3pm)

sasha: reacted :one: (Tue 2pm) — but can move if Thu gets majority

marta: small ask — if you own any service accounts with wide scopes, add a one-line note here (service name + reason). I’ll collate for the meeting doc.

noah: service: metrics-exporter, reason: dashboard ingestion from prod, scope: read-only metrics & push tokens. will submit PR to narrow scope by EOW.

vikram: service: infra-deploy-bot, reason: automated deploys to dedicated pools, scope: deploy+read for infra namespaces. open issue to separate deploy role, link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/412

marta: thanks. I’ll send calendar invite after poll closes and attach pre-reads (ACL export + threat-model + outstanding audit issues). If Thu 3pm wins we’ll allocate first 15m for quick exec summary and then deep dive.

sasha: can we also reserve the last 10m for follow-ups & owner assignments? helps with SLAs.

marta: yes — will block owners in the agenda. anything else?

noah: nope. thanks — looking forward.

sec-bot: Poll closed. Result: majority for :three: (Thu 3pm PT). Calendar invite sent to participants.
